projects.name: MAG Transportation Improvement Program - TIP_Lines (Maricopa Association of Governments, Phoenix region only)
projects.notes: REGIONAL, not statewide: projects in the MAG TIP (Maricopa County and part of Pinal), including ADOT freeway projects in the region. Field names carry long join prefixes. dbo_vwTIPMapData_Completed flags finished work; dbo_vwTIPMapData_DateActiveYear is the year the project becomes active; dbo_vwTIPMapData_AgencyName is the lead agency; dbo_vwTIPMapData_STIPID links to ADOT's eSTIP; Federal/Local/Regional amounts are in dbo_vwTIPMapData_FederalAmount, dbo_vwTIPMapData_LocalAmount, dbo_vwTIPMapData_RegionalAmount (CostEstimate was empty in the sample). Sibling layers: 0 TIP_Points, 2 TIP_Polygons, 3 TIP_Multipoints, 4 TIP_phase (table of work phases). dbo_vwTIPMapData_AirQualityArea is an air-quality area name, the nearest thing to a county field.

projects_note: No current statewide ADOT layer found. ADOT's 2027-2031 Five-Year Program is published as a dashboard (azdot.gov/5yeardashboard returned HTTP 403 to a script) and at estip.azdot.gov; the only ADOT feature services found were old (5YRPlan2023_2024_gdb, FY2023-2024) or carried no project attributes (Updated_eSTIP, ESTIP_Update).
parcels_statewide_note: null: Arizona publishes no free statewide parcel layer with owner names (none found on AZGeo / ArcGIS Online).

parcels_counties.name: Maricopa County Assessor - Parcels
parcels_counties.restrictions: Not checked beyond the layer metadata; review the Maricopa County Assessor's data terms before commercial or mailing use.
parcels_counties.notes: Assessor's own server, 1.76M parcels, tax year 2027 values in the sample. FCV_CUR (full cash value) is TEXT with commas and padding; LAND_SIZE is in square feet, not acres; MAIL_ADDRESS is a concatenated mailing address; INCAREOF, SALE_DATE, SALE_PRICE, DEED_DATE, JURISDICTION also present.

parcels_counties.name: Pinal County tax parcels (copy published by City of Maricopa, TaxParcel_8_26)
parcels_counties.notes: Third-party (city) copy of county tax parcels, dated by its name (8/26); the first sample record had blank attributes, see owner_filled_count. Pinal County's own server was not located.
parcels_counties.approved_note: Approved by the account owner on 2026-11-17: no restriction on commercial use stated.

summary: Projects: no statewide ADOT planned-projects service verified, only the MAG (Phoenix region) TIP layers. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Maricopa County Assessor parcels with owner and mailing address verified, plus a city-hosted copy of Pinal County. Pima (server returned 403), Yavapai (403) and Mohave not verified.
